title: lupinus hirsutus subsp. micranthus
intro: Lupinus hirsutus subsp. micranthus, commonly known as a small-flowered hairy lupine, is a plant species within the lupine family (Fabaceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include supporting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of lupine include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds. These bioactive constituents may also exhibit cardiovascular and neuroprotective effects, although further research is needed to confirm the plant's efficacy and safety for human use.
